facts.fact: The Agence Nigerienne de Presse reports that a national workshop in Maradi on 18-19 May 2026 aimed to popularise Niger's law on the repression of cybercrime, which participants are said to have taken on board.
facts.system: Loi portant repression de la cybercriminalite

NER.note: The consultation was a two-day in-person workshop; no online channel is stated.

facts.fact: The Agence Nigerienne de Presse reports that the national communication observatory held a two-day workshop in Maradi on 18-19 May 2026 with journalists, online media promoters, web-activists and influencers to review and amend the draft ordinance on the electronic press, including regulation of social networks and platforms.
facts.system: Draft ordinance on the electronic press
